title: Jagrav's Low Shield
description:
Lowers the Shield overlay.
Helps in PVP
body:
### What is Jagrav's Low Shield?
Low Shield makes the Shield overlay lower which helps you see more of your screen while using a Shield in Minecraft.
### Why would you Use it?
Low Shield helps you see whats actually happening in game rather than the Vanilla Shield covering a large portion of your screen, it improves visibility and provides a good QOL Experience.
### Who would use it?
- Players who do PVP
- Players who frequently use Shields
- Players who just play regular Singleplayer/Multiplayer Minecraft
- Players who just want a good QOL Experience
